Do NOT use impossible drone movements. Keep the action readable. During the fracture moment, slightly increase the push-in toward Shiryu's upper body and injured right arm. Queen remains wounded in the background. No additional attacks. No energy explosions filling the entire screen. No giant magical beam. No transformation. No new characters. No dialogue required. Gordon emits a low aggressive exertion grunt. Strong atmospheric wind. Distant low thunder. No music required unless added later in editing.
